title: Sinner powers past Alcaraz to win Shanghai title
summary: Jannik Sinner produced a near-flawless serving display to beat Carlos Alcaraz in straight sets and lift the Shanghai Masters trophy, tightening the race for year-end No. 1.

title: Sabalenka seals year-end No. 1 for third straight season
summary: A quarter-final run in Wuhan was enough for Aryna Sabalenka to lock up the WTA year-end top spot, joining an elite group to finish three consecutive seasons on top.

title: Gauff rallies from a set down to win Wuhan title
summary: Coco Gauff saved two championship points before overpowering Iga Swiatek in a two-and-a-half-hour final to claim her second Wuhan trophy.

title: Draper withdraws from indoor swing with arm injury
summary: British No. 1 Jack Draper has pulled out of Vienna and Paris as he continues to manage a bone bruise in his left arm, putting his ATP Finals hopes in doubt.

title: Fonseca wins first indoor title in Stockholm
summary: Brazilian teenager Joao Fonseca continued his rapid rise with a commanding victory in the Stockholm final, his third tour-level title of the season.

title: Race to Turin: five players chasing the last three spots
summary: With Basel, Vienna and Paris still to come, the battle for the final places at the Nitto ATP Finals has never been tighter. We break down every scenario.

title: Mboko breaks into the top 10 after Ningbo semi-final
summary: Canadian Victoria Mboko has become the youngest woman in the top 10 after reaching the last four in Ningbo, capping a breakout season.

title: Djokovic confirms Paris Masters return
summary: Novak Djokovic will play the Rolex Paris Masters for the first time in three years as he targets a record-extending eighth ATP Finals title.

title: Zheng Qinwen set for comeback in Tokyo
summary: Olympic champion Zheng Qinwen has accepted a wildcard into the Pan Pacific Open, her first event since elbow surgery in the summer.

title: Anisimova and Pegula lead US charge into WTA Finals
summary: For the first time since 2002, four American women are on course to qualify for the season-ending championships in Riyadh.

title: Rune targets Paris for return from Achilles injury
summary: Holger Rune says he is "90 per cent" ready after seven months out, with the Dane planning to test his Achilles at the final Masters 1000 of the year.

title: Inside the numbers: how Alcaraz rebuilt his second serve
summary: A deep dive into the tactical tweaks behind Carlos Alcaraz’s improved hold percentage in 2026 — and why it matters on the quick indoor courts ahead.

title: Osaka out of Tokyo with abdominal strain
summary: Naomi Osaka has withdrawn from her home event in Tokyo after scans revealed a grade-one abdominal strain sustained during practice in Ningbo.

title: Mensik and Lehecka power Czech resurgence
summary: With two men inside the top 20 for the first time in over a decade, Czech tennis is enjoying a golden generation on both tours.

title: Swiatek splits with coach ahead of 2027 season
summary: Iga Swiatek has announced she will part ways with her coaching team at the end of the season, saying she needs "a new voice" for the next chapter.

title: Basel draw: Sinner headlines stacked field
summary: Jannik Sinner is the top seed at the Swiss Indoors, with Taylor Fritz, Ben Shelton and home favourite Stan Wawrinka also in the draw.

title: Andreeva: "I want to win a Slam next year"
summary: Mirra Andreeva opens up on her goals for 2027, her new fitness programme and learning to manage expectations at 19.

title: Tour confirms new calendar changes for 2027
summary: The ATP and WTA have jointly announced a revised schedule for 2027, including a longer off-season and fewer mandatory events for top players.

title: Shelton’s serve speed record falls in Almaty
summary: Giovanni Mpetshi Perricard thundered down a 247 km/h first serve in Almaty, the fastest recorded on tour this season.

title: Paolini and Errani qualify for Riyadh doubles
summary: The Italian pair booked their place at the WTA Finals for a third straight year after a title run in Beijing.

title: Fritz and Paul commit to United Cup
summary: Team USA will be led by Taylor Fritz and Tommy Paul as they look to reclaim the mixed-team title in Australia this January.
